lead: A one-line strip that loops announcements or updates too long to fit. It stays still when the content fits; it pauses when the pointer or focus enters and has a pause button; when the system asks for reduced motion it doesn't scroll and becomes manually scrollable instead.

basic.title: Basic
basic.label: Announcements
basic.news: Sortable, Marquee, TagInput and Statistic.Countdown are now in the library · DatePicker learns weeks, months, quarters and years · Table gets fixed columns ·

short.title: Content that fits
short.description: When the content fits, it doesn't scroll, isn't duplicated and has no pause button.
short.label: Short

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.parts: The clipping window, the animated track and the content (two copies while scrolling, the copy `aria-hidden` + `inert`)
styling.pause: The pause button; `data-paused` isn't on it, read `aria-pressed`
